contract: Delina, Wild Mage attacks (P0), trigger targets P0's Grizzly Bears, roll resolves. 1-14 branch (control): exactly one tapped/attacking non-legendary Bear token copy with the granted end-of-combat exile ability. 15-20 branch (reported): a token is created AND an optional 'you may roll again' prompt is offered; each further 15-20 may repeat.
limitations: Browser UI not exercised; native engine via two human-client seats.
8x Delina / 12x Grizzly Bears / 30x Llanowar Elves deck density is a test-harness convenience (engine accepts >4-of for custom games).

The die roll value is not exposed to the client (no RollResult waiting_for, nothing in server.log); the 15-20 branch is identified by its effect signature (trigger fired, 0 new tokens) since the 1-14 branch provably creates exactly one token.
The prebuilt server has no standalone state-restore; states are authoritative exports (restorable only via full game replay).
Verdict is scoped to v0.80.0; not tested on the original 2026-08-02 build, so this is not a fix claim.
observations: A1: pre.json (turn 36 PreCombatMain, active P0): Delina on BF, Bear on BF, life 20/20.
A2: Delina's attack trigger answered twice: turn 38 and turn 40 both targeted P0's Grizzly Bears (waiting_for type on protocol 69 is 'TriggerTargetSelection').

A3 (low branch, turn 38): exactly 1 new P0 token: Grizzly Bears copy, tapped, attacking, is_token, no Legendary supertype, carries granted ability 'at end of combat, exile ~.' (CreateDelayedTrigger/AtNextPhase(EndCombat)).
A4 (high branch, turn 40): trigger fired, target answered, resolution produced 0 new tokens (15-20 signature).
A5: no 'you may roll again' prompt on the high turn. The engine surfaced a single OptionalEffectChoice for P0 with EMPTY text/candidates (source_id=37, Delina) — answered 'true'.
A6 not-run: no reroll prompt was offered, so the reroll accept/decline branch could not be exercised. Accepting the empty-texted prompt changed nothing (final token delta 0).

A7: the low-branch token's granted end-of-combat exile ability did not exile it: token still on the battlefield at PostCombatMain (stack empty), and still present at turn 40 PostCombatMain. Recorded as a related gap against the triage acceptance criteria (tokens retain the end-of-combat exile modification), not the reported claim.

Secondary: pinned card data (v0.80.0) parses the 15-20 branch as effect=Unimplemented('create') with sub_ability=Unimplemented (the 'you may roll again' clause), i.e. the reroll is an engine/parser gap, not a UI prompt failure.

Driver notes: (1) on protocol 69 the trigger target prompt is waiting_for type 'TriggerTargetSelection' (a prior run stalled answering only 'TargetSelection'). (2) OptionalEffectChoice opportunities carry empty text; discriminate reroll prompts by roll mention in prompt text — here none matched.
scenario: scenario_6866.py (SETUP -> ATTACK loop; watchdog 14 attack turns; exports pre/mid/post for the first low and high turns)
